high_level_description: The image features a person standing indoors, posing confidently with one hand on their hip and the other resting near their waist. The individual is wearing a black corset-style top adorned with colorful floral patterns and lace-up details at the front. They have paired this with high-waisted, light blue denim jeans that are slightly cropped. The person accessorizes with gold jewelry, including a watch on their left wrist, rings on their fingers, and a necklace with a small pendant.
